operator_context: User reported done following explicit instructions for 05 Polling 500 to 1000. Original notes call it Dpi change from 500 to 1k; interpreted in the guided polling-rate context, without modifying the original notes.

analysis_window.scope_note: Historical totals are full-capture counts. Setting-change comparisons use this time window and separate startup matching.

findings.finding: The second burst matches all 867 candidate command-18 data-stage byte strings of the prior 1000 Hz Apply sequence.
Compared with 04 at 500 Hz, the second burst differs at one candidate record: byte 6 is 00 instead of 01.
The first burst has the 500 Hz candidate value 01 and the known startup value 00 at record 131, so it is kept separate from Apply.

limitations: First 5 seconds are excluded; later startup is classified separately.
VirtualBox uses separate control-phase setup slots and many captured records are shortened.
Block coordinates are not proven physical memory addresses.
UI/configuration mapping does not establish measured physical USB reporting frequency, persistent device storage, or safe standalone Linux replay.
No captured command was replayed by the analyst.
publication_note: Local VM names and host-assigned USB UUIDs are redacted; personal absolute paths are normalized. Capture hashes, packet evidence and findings are retained. Raw captures remain private.
